The Topology Boundary Auditor's high mask confidence (0.96) is misleading here; it simply segmented the fused mass as one object, failing to detect the internal anatomical error, which validates the need for the Router's visual inspection over blind reliance on segmentation masks.

This significant morphological deviation lowers the alignment score well below the passing threshold, despite the correct class label prediction.
